title: Panel release debrief snippets - 2026-09-15
content:
Meeting: Panel release debrief / quick sync
Date: 2026-09-15 10:30-11:00 PT
Facilitator: Aisha
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Rosa, Ethan, Priya, Ben (observability)
Purpose: capture immediate learnings from the 09/14 panel rollout, list short-term mitigations and owners, surface follow-ups for next week. Keep terse — this is field notes for the release lead.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Canary showed a small but sustained bump in client-side errors and a 20ms median latency increase in panel render path.
- Root cause appears to be a double-sampling interaction between analytics sampling and the new suggestions fetch path (race leads to extra metric tagging + extra logging).
- Quick mitigation: adjust sampling guard in analytics lib and add debounce to suggestions call. Hotfix PR ready for review (see linked PR).

Observations / Data points:
- Canary traffic window: 9/14 17:00-23:30 UTC.
- Error spike: client error rate from 0.12% -> 0.28% (relative +133%) during 17:15-18:10 UTC.
- Latency: panel median render 120ms -> 140ms for the affected cohort (approx +20ms). 95p increased ~35ms.
- Logs: increased JSON payload size for telemetry events by ~8% correlating with spike.
- Traces: many traces missing "panel_variant" tag due to instrumentation ordering.

What happened (short timeline):
- 16:45 UTC: rollout of panel v2 to 5% via feature flag.
- 17:05 UTC: first telemetry aggregation shows higher-than-expected logging volume.
- 17:15 UTC: UX team reports intermittent panel jumpiness on Slack (#panel-rollouts).
- 17:30 UTC: SRE/Observability confirms elevated error rate and trace gaps.
- 18:00 UTC: Created hotfix branch - analytics sampling guard + debounce + trace-tag ordering fix.

Immediate actions taken (owners):
- Hotfix PR prepared: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4321 (owner: Marcus Liu). Status: ready for review.
- Rollout pause: paused additional ramp from 5% -> 20% (owner: Aisha).
- Canary monitoring dashboards annotated with incident window (owner: Ben).
- Revert plan: prepared fast rollback playbook if hotfix doesn't reduce error rate within 2 hours (owner: Priya).

Short-term mitigations (next 24-48h):
- Merge hotfix and re-run canary at 5% for 3h observation window. (owner: Marcus)
- Add debounce (200ms) to suggestions fetch to reduce duplicate calls; ensure unit tests cover timing edge cases. (owner: Rosa)
- Add a guard in analytics lib to drop duplicate telemetry events when trace id is missing. (owner: Ethan)
- Patch instrumentation so traces include panel_variant before telemetry emission (owner: Ben)

Open questions / risks: 
- Is the increased logging cost material for billing? early estimate: +3-5% ingestion for the day, finance to be notified if sustained. (action: Aisha to ping finance)
- Could the debounce/guard mask other regressions (i.e., hide a functional bug)? Need targeted QA scripts to validate behavior. (action: Priya to coordinate QA)
- Any downstream analytics consumers relying on the previous sample semantics? Need to notify analytics consumers about guard change. (action: Marcus draft notice)

Decisions made: 
- Do not rollback immediately; try hotfix first because symptoms point to instrumentation/race, not logic regressions.
- Pause ramp beyond 5% until hotfix observed for minimum 3h with stable metrics.

Follow-ups and owners (concrete tickets):
- ROLL-1254: implement sampling guard + tests (assignee: Marcus Liu)
- CORE-987: fix trace tagging ordering in frontend instrumentation (assignee: Ben)
- UI-5231: debounce suggestions + add e2e for scroll stability (assignee: Rosa Hernández)
- OPS-441: billing preview for increased telemetry ingestion (assignee: Aisha Patel)

Notes to keep (less formal):
- UX anecdote: some users reported the panel "jump" felt like content reflow; appears tied to suggestions replacement layout. Try slightly smoother CSS transition as follow-up. (Rosa)
- SRE thought: error stack traces look like occasional undefined when telemetry payload malformed — we should add a defensive schema validate at emission time. (Ethan)

Next sync: 2026-09-16 09:30 PT quick status, or earlier if PR merges / rollback triggered.
Parking lot (deferred):
- Deeper perf profiling of panel painter (task for perf sprint).
- Investigate incremental hydration approach for later cycles.

Attachments / quick refs: linked PR, dashboards (annotation), jira keys above.

If you have any quick wins to add to the hotfix PR (tiny fixes that don't change UX contract), paste into the PR thread and tag @Marcus.

-- Aisha
